institutionName: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Norway is very close to Denmark, but I felt that I knew very little of it despite of that.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Some of courses were very good, while some were quite bad.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: They have a very good system for receiving students

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Quite easy. I would recommend the on campus housing for everyone. It is quite cheap.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is quite easy to find something for the spring semester at least. Consider arriving a week early and spend the first week to find a place.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You have to apply for the courses you want, and then you have to get the approval of the teacher for some of the courses.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: An exchange student center. They respond very quickly.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: It is hard to figure out the schedules for the courses you want, and you can drop courses until quite late. So I would recommend applying for 10 courses of something like that and then dropping courses.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The courses were more practically oriented than at KU.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
This course was very bad:
https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/courses/TDT4310#tab=omEmnet
I would avoid it at all costs.
I took a course in statistics, which was very hard, but that was mainly due to my lack of statistical knowledge.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/courses/TDT4265/#tab=omEmnet
It is a very practical course in computer vision and deep learning in general. The lectures were great, and I felt like I learned something from the assignments.
